versions.content: The DM01 shall use for all configured DM1 messages (J1939DcmDmxSupport == J1939DCM_DM01_SUPPORT) on all nodes (J1939DcmNode) and on all cha nnels (J1939DcmDiagnosticMessageSupportChannelRef) the common sequence of chapter 7.6.1 ‘ DTC status ’ with the parameters ‘ DTCStatusFilter ’ and ‘DTCKind’ according to Table 2 .
